name: Lesson 1: Skimming to predict context before listening
descriptionHtml:
1. Question type

In this part of the test, you should skim the questions and answer choices to predict what you are going to hear. 

 

2. Guide to answer

- Use the time before listening to predict the context. This can make the listening easier. Use the key information in the answer choices to make a rough guess about what you are going to hear.

- Listening carefully and choosing the correct answer.
